text: Never trust this uncle's sure-shot tip. Ninety one percent lost money.
Arjun, listen to me. Options trading. Ten thousand becomes one lakh in one month. It is a sure shot!
Really, Mama? I'm opening my app right now!
Says me! Everybody is making money.
So Amma checked. And the government had already counted every single trader.

In one year, ninety one out of every hundred F and O traders lost money. Together, they lost one lakh, five thousand crore rupees. The average trader lost about one lakh. Ten times Arjun's ten thousand.
Kanna, three questions before any tip. Who gains if you follow it? Will he show his own profit and loss? And how much can you lose?
And Kasi, first show us your own trading account!
Send this to the uncle in your family group. Follow for more money truths. Next time Kasi Mama calls...
